mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS paperId, p.title, b.name AS bankName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_paper_question pq WHERE pq.paper_id = p.id) AS questionCount, p.total_score AS totalScore, p.duration_sec AS durationSec, agg.total_score AS myScore, DATE_FORMAT(agg.submitted_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS mySubmittedAt FROM exam_paper p JOIN question_bank b ON b.id = p.bank_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT paper_id, SUM(score) AS total_score, MAX(submitted_at) AS submitted_at FROM answer_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY paper_id ) agg ON agg.paper_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT pq.seq, pq.question_id AS questionId, q.type, q.stem, q.options AS optionsJson, pq.score FROM exam_paper_question pq JOIN question q ON q.id = pq.question_id WHERE pq.paper_id = #{paperId} ORDER BY pq.seq
